notes.title: 0.88 Custom Levels, Workshop Support, Map Updates
notes.content:
[b]0.883 Custom Maps/Level Editor, new room in Stronghold, visual changes.[/b]
- Adjusted color grade slightly.
- Replaced corridor from the starting room in stronghold with an extended outside section.
- Removed wind effect sound from the start of the game.
- New custom maps! Workshop support! Level editor!
- Zombie pushing is a little weaker.

Since I'll most likely not be releasing any new maps before the full Imperium release, I've decided it might be nice to release workshop support and a level editor in the meantime, so people can try out some alternate maps. I've provided a re-imagined version of Nacht on the workshop to kick things off - feel free to duplicate it and have a look at how it's been set up to make your own.

[i]note, multiplayer for custom maps will be added in a future update[/i]

Here's a link to the workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=3370660&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems

notes.title: 0.87 Map Update. Movement Overhaul. Controller Improvements. Balance Changes.
notes.content:
0.87 Map Update. Movement Overhaul. Controller Improvements. Balance Changes.
- Zombie spawn times rebalanced.
- Speed boost treasure is now diminishing and has lower base move speed increase.
- Burning effect deals less damage.
- Jump now imparts a small amount of speed in the direction you jump.
- Phase travels further if you are in the air.
- Sprint headbob updated.
- Sprint now lasts for less time, but recharges much faster.
- Jumping now 'consumes' stamina/sprint.
- Sprint now starts almost instantaneously.
- You can now animation cancel the part of the wind-down of the first attack of a melee weapon with sprint.
- Added seperate sensitivity slider for controllers.
- You can now scroll in the options menu with controller.
- Fixed an issue where projectiles would collide with mana and essence orbs.
- Fixed some Skeleton pathing issues.
- Mana gain is increased from soul boxes.
- Increased max spawned enemy count.
- Increased zombie attack wind up speed.
- Zombie speed calculation reworked. Slow + medium + fast zombies of different set speeds are now mixed in together at all rounds, with a gradual increase in speed types seen.
- If you take any damage while sprinting, you will now stop sprinting.
- Spell initial costs rebalanced (therefore scaling is also rebalanced), spell costs now are rounded to the nearest 50.
- Zombie general attack speeds increased.
- Health potion treasure added.
- Extensive visual improvements to Stronghold.
- Rocks/Props and other obstacles added nearby popular train spots.

notes.title: 0.7 Mystery Weapon Chest + 11 Weapons! Treasure! Difficulty updates!
notes.content:
[u][b]Treasure![/b][/u]
- In order to increase build variety and replayability, treasure has been introduced!
- Treasure works similarly to items in roguelike games, giving unique or stacking bonuses to the player.
- The price of treasure goes up each round, making acquiring it a large sacrifice in later rounds, but also giving players something extra to spend souls on.
- Treasure is individual to each player in the game.
- The treasure buyable is in spawn, allowing players to begin the game with more interesting choices from the first few rounds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45201682/c9a7c4e61c8bad92c1ae0b205e3ab2b84a43968d.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Loads of New Weapons, And a Weapon Chest![/b][/u]
Weapons added:
- Javelin
- Heavy Sword
- Longsword
- Axe
- War Hammer
- Scimtar
- Rapier
- Spear
- Flamberge
- Great Axe
- Heavy Dagger
- Some of these weapons now have melee weapon wall buys associated with them around the map.
- Any other weapons inaccessible from the wall, and including any other weapons on the wall, will now be purchasable through a random weapon chest in the library.
- Weapons now have durability, and any weapon below a certain durability will become significantly weaker. Weapons can be re-bought to repair, or can be repaired at the blacksmith in the sacrifice room for a hefty fee.
- Enemies killed by any means other than melee will drop a repair durability orb.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45201682/e0168509764f365f9882d4b050af63085edc07dd.jpg[/img]


[u]Difficulty & Other Changes[/u]
- To offset the addition of new weapons, the weapon chest, and treasure; difficulty has been upped, feel free to provide your experience with the new difficulty changes in the feedback form on the main menu as it will help fine tune future difficulty changes.
- Players can now push zombies slightly.
- Reduced windup of zombie attacks.
- Adjusted damage FX.
- Increased zombie attack speed.
- Increased zombie attack hitbox.
- Increased chance for fast zombies.
- Added zombie speed increase.
- Reduced player walk speed slightly.
- Added 1 way route from spawn to courtyard.
- Added some text to game over screen.

Big update so apologies if I missed anything out!

- Enemies killed by any means other than melee will drop a repair durability orb.
- Players can now push zombies slightly.
- Reduced windup of zombie attacks.
- Adjusted damage FX.
- Increased zombie attack speed.
- Increased zombie attack hitbox.
- Increased chance for fast zombies.
- Added zombie speed increase.
- Added 1 way route from spawn to courtyard.
- Added some text to game over screen.
